profile_text.body:
Duolingo is a publicly traded company, listed under the ticker DUOL, that describes itself on its site as a way to learn languages by playing a game. The company says its service is 100 percent free, fun, and scientifically proven to work, and calls itself the world's most popular way to learn a language, with practice available on duolingo.com or through its apps.

Its tracked education product is Duolingo for Schools, listed under Education and Research AI, which the company describes as offering adaptive assignments. It is aimed at students and teachers and is free. According to the product record, users under 13 are allowed with restrictions: no public profile, leaderboards, forums, or social logins, and non-personalized ads for users under 16. The same record states there is no signed California Student Data Privacy Agreement per a K-12 data leadership directory.

The company's profile lists a CIK of 0001562088 and identifies it as a for-profit public company. No lawsuits or MCP servers are recorded for it.
